title: Jehoiakim
lead: King of Judah 609-598 BC, a son of Josiah whom Pharaoh Neco made king in place of his brother Jehoahaz and renamed from Eliakim. He served Nebuchadnezzar three years and then rebelled (2 Kings 23:34-24:1). Jeremiah condemned him for building a palace by unpaid labor (Jeremiah 22:13-19), and he cut up and burned Jeremiah's first scroll (Jeremiah 36:20-32).
